title: YOUVA EdAI Eternal Non-Negotiables That Never Sunset

principles.rationale: Mastery certification, consent changes, role changes, and safety-incident closure remain human-only, forever — not just through Phase 8, but for the life of the product.
principles.enforcementMechanism: Deterministic code assertion and cryptographic signature verification on all consequential API endpoints.

principles.rationale: Every new feature, market, or integration gets a named, demand-backed reason before it's built — this discipline doesn't expire once the company is bigger.
principles.enforcementMechanism: Demand gate validation script and institutional letter-of-intent / contract verification before feature activation.

principles.statement: No safety claim without independent verification.
principles.rationale: Internal test scripts passing is never sufficient evidence on its own for anything touching child safety, security, or compliance.
principles.enforcementMechanism: Dual-attestation requirement: internal automated tests plus signed external auditor/counsel attestation artifact.

principles.statement: Depth before breadth, at every scale.
principles.rationale: The instinct that governed tier-by-tier expansion (Middle School -> High School -> Kindergarten) should govern every future expansion too — new subjects, new markets, new age bands — one at a time, validated before the next.
principles.enforcementMechanism: Sequential gate validator blocking multi-tier or multi-subject expansion until prerequisite tier exit metrics pass.
